host: AWS EC2 m7i.xlarge, 4 vCPU, 16 GiB, us-east-2, Ubuntu 24.04, Docker 29.1.3

configs.stock: dynamicconfig/development-sql.yaml as published; history.transferProcessorMaxPollRPS left at its default of 20
configs.tuned: same, plus history.transferProcessorMaxPollRPS: 1000 (confirmed applied in the temporal server log)

fibo33_note: Three naive-recursive fibo(33) calls timed inside each worker container with that runtime's monotonic clock (time.monotonic / process.hrtime.bigint). fibo(33)=3524578 verified in both.
method: Per combination: one worker process serving one task queue, 6 sequential workflows with a 5s gap between them; workflow 0 discarded as warmup, workflows 1-5 reported. Timings come from each workflow's event history (ActivityTaskScheduled / ActivityTaskStarted / ActivityTaskCompleted), read afterwards by a single Python reader for both languages. No harness wall-clock is used in the reported numbers.
